title: The same 'Enable See Financial Data?' dialog appears for Invoicing & payments when See Financial Data is OFF
custom_preconds: 1. Open Create Role (or edit a custom role) with See Financial Data OFF.
custom_steps: 1. Tick the Invoicing & payments Create & Edit box.
custom_expected:
The same dialog titled 'Enable See Financial Data?' appears, with Cancel and Enable buttons.

It explains that Invoicing & payments needs See Financial Data; only the area name differs from the Part sales version.
evidence: Same 'Enable See Financial Data?' modal confirmed in build. Tick behavior needs live role editor.
